module "P_ClearCopy.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_ClearCopy"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  buffer "Field" RGBA16F resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=None mips=1 history
  buffer "Grey" R16F resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  buffer "Spot" RGBA8 resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(1, 0.5, 0.25, 0) mips=1 export
  pass "Fill" clear injection=AfterOpaque
    value=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    write Grey = Grey
  pass "Mark" clear injection=AfterOpaque
    value=(1, 0, 0, 1)
    write Field = Field
  pass "Keep" copy injection=BeforePostProcess
    read Field = Field.Previous
    write Spot = Spot
  pass "Show" copy injection=BeforePostProcess
    read Grey = Grey
    write SceneColor = SceneColor
